title: Board → page WebSocket message
description: Every text frame the Board sends on /ws. See docs/api/README.md for the rules (seq, liveness, patch semantics) that a schema cannot express. Receivers ignore fields they don't know, so object schemas here do not set additionalProperties:false.

seq.description: Per-connection message counter. A snapshot is always 0; every later message on the same connection is exactly one more than the previous one, ticks and errors included.

snapshot.description: The complete state. Sent right after the WebSocket opens, after a resync, and whenever the Catalog changes.

patch.description: One or more top-level sections that changed. Each section present replaces that section of the page's state wholesale; there is no merging inside a section. The Catalog never changes by patch: a Catalog change is always a new snapshot.

tick.description: Liveness only. Sent when nothing else has gone out for the tick interval.

error.description: The Board rejected a command. Success is never acknowledged with a message of its own; it shows up as the state change (a current patch).

id.description: The id of the rejected command. Absent only when the command was so malformed that no id could be read.

message.description: English detail for logs and the console. The page never shows it to the user.

build.description: Identifies the firmware image (and therefore the page) the Board is running: the git commit it was built from, with -dirty appended for uncommitted changes. The page has its own build id baked in at build time and reloads itself when they differ.

catalog.description: The Board's listing of the Quad Cortex's Folders and Presets.

generation.description: Identifies this version of the Catalog. Changes whenever the Board re-reads the listing. A switchPreset must quote it.

presetCount.description: How many Presets the Quad Cortex reported, which can be more than are listed when incomplete is true.

incomplete.description: True when the listing is partial: it is still being read, or it did not fit the Board's buffers.

index.description: The Preset's position across the whole Catalog (not within its Folder). Unique within one generation.

current.description: The Current preset: what the Quad Cortex reports as loaded. All fields are null when the Board doesn't know.

scene.description: Reserved for scene support (#21). Always null for now.

link.description: The Link: the Board's USB connection to the Quad Cortex.
